messages:
rachel_sales: Small ask — HealthGrid (regional health-tech integrator) requesting an early-adopter amendment. They want 20% off Dedicated list for year1, onboarding fee reduced by 50%, and Net45. In return they'll sign a 24mo consumption commitment (floors) with a technical case study.

emma_dealdesk: What's the exact commitment floor and expected TCV? Any precedent for floor-based pricing?

rachel_sales: Proposed TCV = $360k at the discounted rate (list $450k). Commitment: minimum 4M tokens/month starting month 4; if they exceed 6M tokens/month we auto-bump capacity. They also want a retro credit if consumption falls below 50% of floor in any quarter.

craig_finance: Floor-based commits complicate billing. Quick calc:
```
List: $450,000
Proposed: $360,000 (20% off)
Commit floor: 4M tokens/month
Upside: expected scale to 8M tokens/mo in year2
Estimated margin: ~21% with floor met
```
Finance can provisionally accept if: (1) 25% non-refundable initial milestone invoice, (2) explicit clawback if they under-deliver vs floor (we recoup prorated discount), (3) Net45 OK, (4) no retro credits beyond a one-time balancing credit for quarter 1. Also need clear token metering SLA.

nina_revops: Operational items: need alerting for floor thresholds, automatic scaling policy defined, and a playbook for sudden over-usage. Also SKU mapping: are tokens counted across Hosted+Dedi? Need billing team input.

theo_legal: I'll draft an amendment including consumption floor, clawback math, measurement window, and case-study clause. We'll avoid open-ended retro credits; any balancing credit must be capped and time-limited. Also add standard DPA and right-to-audit clause for onboarding security checks.

rachel_sales: The customer insists on no upfront >15% due to procurement rules. They will supply a signed procurement letter and a PO within 30 days. Can we lower the upfront to 15%?

craig_finance: Finance can make an exception to 15% non-refundable upfront (instead of 25%) only if we get: signed PO within 15 days, an executive budget-holder email confirming the timeline, and stronger clawback (full prorated recoupment of discount for any quarter under 75% of floor). Otherwise stick to 25%.

emma_dealdesk: Proposed trade: 15% upfront + PO in 15 days, stronger clawback, onboarding fee 50% credit to be applied over first 3 invoices, explicit no-stacking with other promos, and a published joint case study at 6 months. If they refuse, reroute to normal playbook pricing.

billing-bot: Draft invoice/credit doc created: /invoices/templates/healthgrid_floor_commitment_v1.docx

rachel_sales: I'll push procurement for PO and budget email. Will post PO and customer redlines here when available. Thanks team. :pray:

craig_finance: Marking provisional approval pending PO + signed amendment + budget-holder confirmation. Once docs are in, AR will configure metering and credits. :white_check_mark:
